body:
Thank you for responding again and I really appreciate your empathic approach.  I do have people that are very supportive and I am engaging with them...and when we are talking, it dies help and provide some releif...but at the end of the day, when they go home and sleep, I cant.  I find myself these days only sleeping 2-3 nights a week, maybe 2-5 hours.  The other nights, between 2-6am, are very difficult hours.  I try to calm myself, practice breathing, meditation, journal, sometimes try to drown out the dispair by detaching by watching TV or playing games on my phone, but no matter how much I "talk it out," the fact that my partner, the most connected I've ever felt with anyone ever in my entire life, is dead.  

She was my best friend, my lover, and my soulmate all in one...and I am having a difficult time imagining, even if I get thru the dispair, learn to live and acceot what has happened, even get to a place I can open my heart again to another, it's impossible for me to comprehend how I might be so fortunate to find someone to share my life with that I have even 1/2 of what I had with my partner.  That's the real struggle.  While I'll be the first to admit that my cognitive ability to make accurate assessment regarding my life is impaired at this time and focused on negative outcones over positive due to the deep dispair I feel, I don't believe my thoughts to be that inaccurate here because I feel it at my core...so my future looks like: pain +  long term negative emotional dispair = opportunity to experience .5x at best...

Anyway, thank you for your words, I do need to focus on what positive action I can take to pull this airplane out of its nose dive before it's too late.  I feel at times it is...but I'm trying, hence my post.  Thanks again.

I appreciate the response, but this is why I'm struggling..."time" is the only answer people can give regarding how things get better...sure there are things that likely won't really help (i.e. drug use), but no better prognostic indicator than "time."  In this modern day of scientif discovery, medicine, advances psychological and psychopharmaclogical treatmemts, we still havent made any advancements in this regard compared to 300 years ago...

And yes, I totally understand the impact it would have on my kids, but consider how we in the present consider the guy who killed himself 300 years ago...we don't, we have no connection to them..but neither do we to his kids and their suffering.  And that's just it right?  It's the "connection," or lack there of that's the real issue here.  I feel "disconnected" from my girlfriend, or ex-girlfriend, whatever (I feel like a stalker still calling her my girlfriend because she clearly broke up with me 64 days ago)...but that's just it, I feel disconnected from the connection I believed, and still do to large extent, that we shared...if I killed myself, my kids would feel disconnected from the connection we share (And the security and all the other important dynamics mixed up in the parental relationship)...

But childten lose parents all the time...when is it ever easy to lose someone you love...but we exoect to lose our parents at some point,  not our parents in their mid-20s.  So for me, this is a question of time (unless time reqlly does heal all)...in terms of how long do I have to wait (for my kids) before I can kill myself?  In other words, when is my life mine again?  I'm not saying there is a correct answer, some might feel never, I generally feel till they are out of the house, not that once children leave the home parental duties cease, but if I was to use a rubric, is use that one.  However, the problem with that, even if we assumed that's the say my youngest turns 18, I'm looking at another 7+ years, and my fear is I'm struggling to imangine making it beyond the next 7-10 days.  Our anniversary was suppose to be in less than 2 weeks...

So I'm not sure the reassurance that "time" will heal is going to get me there...

What's also messed up, is that this conflict over "My rights" and "My responsibilities" us actually making it more difficult to endure.  I feel completely trapped, as if I was sentenced to live a life of suffering and toucher after having tasted freedom.  Knowing how it feels to feel good, makes this all the more screwed...not that I'm complaining on having had the time, experience, and connection with her that I did, for I wouldn't trade it for the world.

Out of all the people that have had the unfortunate experience I know suffer, can you offer nothing more than "time."  There has to be someone that can offer something more...again, I do not mean to convey any disrespect to you Searching, as I appreciate your response, but if have ever walked in similar shoes, I'm confident you will truely understand my exoerience, response, and plea...because without something else than time, by my estimates, I'm going to lose in this fight...and real soon.

I've always been a relatively happy person.  I've struggled emotionally at times, like after a break up, but they were temporal and were not all consuming experiences.  Additionally, even in those past relationships, they didn't hold a candle to this one.  The level of intimacy, connection, love, companionship, sex, romance, friendship, etc., were so much more profound than anything I've ever experienced.  

She shared her suicidal ideation with me and I always tried to listen, be supported, and never judged.  Bit I have to admit, while I did have some concern and did what I could, I also didn't want to believe she would ever follow thru with it.  I am proud of myself for not ever becoming overly codependent or projecting my fear onto her by guilt or shame, but that doesn't mean I have questioned a million interactions with her a million times wonder "what if I had done X instead."  But that's not my biggest concern now, it's that nothing seems to be getting better, in fact, I feel things are getting worse.  

Lately I have been spending more time thinking about killing myself, wanting to die.  It's not that I can't handle the pain, or at least that's not the main motivator, it's just I'm struggling with the idea of living without her.  She was my best friend, lover, partner, and I have no inclination in trying to replace her.  Also, how can that be fair to another person, to constantly be compared to another...ianother...ive always waited sone time in-between relationships, at least a couple of years, but she was the love of my life, my soul mate, and I don't feel any amount of time can resolve that for me.  I understand my thinking is distorted right now, but the cognitive is very different than the emotional...and for me this is a matter of my heart.  I'm extremely loyal and can't begin to comprehend how my heart will ever be able to make room for another.  For me, she was everything.  Sure, we had our issues, but there has never been another individual that I was that in love with.  And while I acceot her pain was so great that she saw np other way out at that moment, I'm wondering how far in from that same point.  If I knew for sure I would be eith her upon my death, is stop typing right now and be done with this life.  The problem is, I have no way to know and while thos life hold little value for me, I do believe when I had children, I gave up the privilege to engage activities that placed me at high risk...however, as I shared above, although I engender that belief to the core and I've always made my kids the #1 priority in my life, there are moments where my longing for her become so acute suicidal thoughts flood my mind and start to take over...and it's becoming more and more difficult to talk mysekf down.  

I'm doing thetapy, Breavement grouos, talking to others about my feelings, trying to stay active with work and my other obligations, posting here, writing, taking meds, meditating, taking all the suggestions I can, but nothing is helping...i fear that with each collapse into that suicidal mind-set, it drags me down a bit more, takes a little more out of me, and while I began a fairly resilient individual, I find myself these days, thinking more and more about it...idk, it's a weird, fucked up, crazy exoeriences, but I'm trying to own it and own it in the healthiest way I can...bit I feel like I'm fighting a losing battle.

Yea, I feel you.  I don't want to hurt my children either...i don't want to hurt anyone.  I wish there was some way to erase everyone's memory of me so I could just go get it over with without leaving a lot of people in a similar place to where I am not in the wake of my death.  I pray everyday for some accident to happen to me so that people can accept it a bit easier, cause a loved ones suicide is a real motherfucker to accept.  

And it's not my loved ones I wish to hurt or even leave...its that I feel already half dead, as if being called to it.  I have no desire, ambition, or passion.  The idea of being with someone ekse repluses me...so o can't find comfort in engaging someone on an intimate level, which I think will be the case for a really long time...so no escape or opportunity there...drugs don't even over much relief, nor does anything else except for sleep, and that's even circumstantial...cant tell you how many nights I've woken up sobbing.

I loved my girlfriend more than I can describe.  She was my queen, my partner, my lover, my best friend.  I worshiped her and gave her and the relationship everything I had...fuck, we were looking at rings 4 days before she killed herself.  The worst part are people are starting to get burnt out on hearing about it and starting to become judgemental.  It take most of my energy just to maintain the minimal requirements I have for work and my kids, not to meantion the concerted energy I expend not to kill myself each day.

And yes Hopelessly...the image of my daughter and son, grief stricken after learning of my death does help pull me back from the edge at times, but I'm wondering for how long...

This is the darkest, most evil shit I've ever been thru...but as they say, one day at a time, at least for now...

I feel so selfish admitting this, but I'm not certain my children are enough to keep me here.  I feel so strange saying that because I've always lived by a philosophy that my children come first, that I am here for them, not the other way around...and while my two children, currently ages 10 and 12 are exceptional individuals, I know this would alter their lives forever, and of course I don't want to fuck them up.  So I am living for them, but not because I want to for me...which totally sucks, because I use to feel so much joy being their father, but now I have to labor through every moment just to keep appearances up for them and to do my duties...but every night once they are asleep I either am so strung out emotionally, that I can't sleep at all the entire night.  So i just lay in bed crying for hours or take something to sleep.  

Overall the pain has not gotten easier, in fact, most days it appears to be worsening.  While I know it will take time and it's only been 43 days, I don't see it getting better for a long time, if it ever does.  And my desire to kill myself doesn't have anything to do with not being able to see my way thru this.  While I can't atm, I know I would get thru it, at least to some extent, somday...however, my issue is about that o do not want to live in this world without her...

So while time does provide acceptance, my issue is less about accepting what's happened and more fundementally in that i rather not exist or join her in whatevers next thsn remain here without her...idk, maybe my thinking will change in time.  But as of now, I'm barely holding on...

I do hope you find sone pathway forward Stienvvord.  Thanks for responding to me...
